accuracy_claim: NONE - no human ground truth; do not compute accuracy

rates.peak_vram_note: vram_used_after_mib is read after each call; the server holds the model resident, so this is load+inference occupancy, not isolated delta.

detected_cross_boundary_references.note: Every cited frame outside the frozen target interval or not marked as a target-segment frame is flagged by construction; this counter reports how many such citations the model actually made. It does NOT prove that all neighbour mis-attribution is detectable from indices alone -- a note may describe a neighbour event without citing a frame.

gate_note: Gates were fixed before the run. They are engineering-contract gates, not semantic accuracy thresholds. Failing a gate is reported as a failure; thresholds are not adjusted after seeing results.
